value: Very high-scope adventure game with high quality illustrations, interactive gameplay with body exploration and high variety of scenarios. Contains extensive narrative with complete branching endings.

You play as the hero. After defeated the "demon lord", a giant girl calling herself the real demon lord appears and destroys your country. Instantly obliterated with a single breath, your consciousness fades before your goddess brings you back to life. She asks you to journey into the demon lord's world to stop her before she destroys your whole world, aiding you with her weakened goddess powers. 
Upon travelling to the other world you are confronted with the reality that what you formerly thought was an immortal “demon lord” is actually just a cockroach from the other world, and that this world is simply bigger, and stronger than your own.

Explore a large world with a huge variety of fatal and near-death giantess encounters. Switch between giantess and miniguy characters to reach different zones. Includes several body exploration levels.
